fl: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

name: Geodude

atk.x: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

fl: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

name: Gible

atk.x: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

fl: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

name: Kricketot

atk.x: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

fl: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

name: Larvitar

atk.x: You may discard the top card of your deck. If you do, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage and Larvitar is now Asleep.

fl: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

name: Magby

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Magmar from your hand onto Magby (this counts as evolving Magby) and remove all damage counters from Magby.

fl: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.

name: Magikarp

atk.x: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Magikarp.
Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

fl: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

name: Murkrow

atk.x: Search your deck for Murkrow and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Switch Murkrow with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

fl: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.

name: Nidoran ♀

atk.x: Search your deck for Nidoran ♂ or Nidoran ♀ and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

fl: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

name: Paras

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

fl: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

name: Pichu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Pikachu from your hand onto Pichu (this counts as evolving Pichu) and remove all damage counters from Pichu.

fl: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

name: Pikachu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Pichu is anywhere under Pikachu, you may search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. This power can't be used if Pikachu is affected by a Special Condition.

fl: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

name: Remoraid

atk.x: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

fl: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

name: Sandshrew

atk.x: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

fl: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

name: Seel

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

fl: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

name: Shinx

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Shinx.

ru: Rawst Berry: If Shinx is Burned, remove the Special Condition Burned from Shinx at the end of each player's turn.

name: Slakoth

atk.x: Both Slakoth and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.

fl: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Snorunt

atk.x: Draw a card.
Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

fl: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.

name: Snover

atk.x: Look at your opponent's hand.
Flip a coin. If tails, Snover does 10 damage to itself.

fl: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

name: Spheal

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, during your next turn, Spheal's Rollout attack's base damage is 40.

fl: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

name: Spinarak

atk.x: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

fl: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

name: Surskit

atk.x: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

fl: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Teddiursa

atk.x: Remove all Special Conditions and 2 damage counters from Teddiursa. Teddiursa is now Asleep.
Before doing damage, remove 1 damage counter from the Defending Pokémon.

fl: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every sets of paws tastes unique.

name: Totodile

atk.x: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

fl: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer need to be careful.

name: Vulpix

atk.x: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

fl: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Zubat

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

fl: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

name: Bebe's Search
ru: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

name: Dusk Ball
ru: Look at the 7 cards from the bottom of your deck. Choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Put the remaining cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Fossil Excavator
ru: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Search your deck or discard pile for a Trainer card that has Fossil in its name or a Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolution card that evolves from a Fossil. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. If you searched your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Lake Boundary
ru: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Apply Weakness for each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) as ×2 instead.

name: Night Maintenance
ru: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

name: Quick Ball
ru: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Pokémon. Show that Pokémon to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other revealed cards back into your deck. (If you don't reveal a Pokémon, shuffle all the revealed cards back into your deck.)

name: Team Galactic's Wager
ru: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, and you and your opponent play "Rock-Paper-Scissors." The player who wins draws up to 6 cards. The player who loses draws up to 3 cards. (You draw your cards first.)

name: Armor Fossil

ab.x: Whenever Armor Fossil would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, reduce that damage by 10.

ru: Play Armor Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Armor Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Armor Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Armor Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Armor Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

name: Skull Fossil

ab.x: During your opponent's turn, if Skull Fossil would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Attacking Pokémon.

ru: Play Skull Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Skull Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Skull Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Skull Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Skull Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

name: Multi Energy
ru: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) Multi Energy provides Colorless Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

name: Darkness Energy
ru: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't Darkness. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Metal Energy
ru: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal. Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Electivire LV.X

atk.x: Discard all of your opponent's Pokémon Tool cards and Stadium cards in play. If you do, prevent all effects, including damage, done to Electivire during your opponent's next turn.

ab.x: As long as Electivire is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to 1 of his or her Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

ru: Put this card onto your Active Electivire. Electivire LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

name: Lucario LV.X

atk.x: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Lucario by attacks is increased by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put Lucario LV.X from your hand onto your Active Lucario, you may use this power. Prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Lucario during your opponent's next turn. (If Lucario is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.)

ru: Put this card onto your Active Lucario. Lucario LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

name: Magmortar LV.X

atk.x: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Magmortar. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) During your next turn, Magmortar can't use Flame Bluster.

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Magmortar is your Active Pokémon, you may choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Burned. Put 3 damage counters instead of 2 on that Pokémon between turns. This power can't be used if Magmortar is affected by a Special Condition.

ru: Put this card onto your Active Magmortar. Magmortar LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

name: Time-Space Distortion
ru: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.
